content:
I just heard of Vidocq on at https://www.pubhouse.net/podcast/finding-a-marble-in-the-oatmeal/

"Vidocq is a suite of Jakarta EE and MicroProfile runtimes written in pure Java 25, native Java Modules, built on static code generation (Class-File API + APT) and virtual threads." -- https://doc.vidocq.dev/home/

https://vidocq.dev/
You can start watching at 16:20 - https://youtu.be/b3AuRFhIVXg?si=AYecUu0mUldcACBg&t=980
Using the Jakarta and MP TCKs as feedback loop for the agent harness is a perfect use case for AI code generation.
